items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had a band with Kenny Dorham and Art Taylor and Gene Ramey.

ctx.x: I guess you did three 10-inch recordings...or two—one in 1952, one in 1954. The first one is with Horace Silver and Art Blakey and Blue Mitchell, and Gene Ramey.
It wasn’t Art Blakey. Art Taylor. Gene Ramey.
Were these guys you were working with?

items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So you had Horace Silver and Blue Mitchell on the date. Had you been working with Arthur Taylor? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Art Taylor.

ctx.x: So you had Horace Silver and Blue Mitchell on the date. Had you been working with Arthur Taylor?
